top_signals.title: Iran War Has Achieved Nothing But a Cost of Living Crisis Says Gray
top_signals.summary: Leela Gray, a Democratic congressional candidate in Florida and retired army brigadier general, said the war with Iran has "achieved nothing but a cost of living crisis." as we hit the sixth month mark of the Iran War.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: The Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals ruled that sports-related event contracts are not swaps, contradicting a Third Circuit ruling from April.
